title: Bedroom Brickfield
one_line_rule: Tap bricks to reveal them; numbers show neighbouring hidden mines.

brief.intent: Minesweeper but set in a minefield of Lego bricks in a dark bedroom
brief.notes: Hidden LEGO bricks, adjacency counts, flags and first reveal safety.
